legacy_authority.SWQHR1: Q(h) = ALPHAW * max(h-HBWEIR,0)^BETAW with admitted legacy parameter range including nonlinear BETAW values
legacy_authority.SWQHR2: direct tabular HHTAB/QHTAB relation with a separate legacy HBWEIR threshold seam already held by F-PM08D4/F-PM08D5

pinned_ribasim_authority.TabulatedRatingCurve: PCHIP level-to-flow interpolation; the pinned implementation internally augments the supplied knot set, so even a nominal two-point linear input is not an exact hard-kink SWQHR1 representation.
pinned_ribasim_authority.note: ManningResistance is analytical but represents a different hydraulic law and is not treated as an equivalent generic SWAP alpha/beta weir.
pinned_ribasim_authority.ContinuousControl_Function: PCHIP smooth interpolation of input/output datapoints; Q1A-R3 is exact for the frozen linear positive-head interval because its two-point function is linear there, but this does not provide an analytic generic alpha/beta power law.

consequence.Q1A_V1: FALSIFIED exact mapping with three-point TabulatedRatingCurve; PCHIP crest smoothing produced ~8.93e-6 m endpoint level error in C1.
consequence.Q1A_R2: FALSIFIED exact mapping with two supplied TabulatedRatingCurve points because Ribasim internally augments the knot set before PCHIP.
consequence.Q1A_R3_R3L: PASS for BETAW=1 using ContinuousControl + one-way Pump, including direct connector mass ledger.
consequence.forbidden_generalization: The linear R3/R3L pass does not establish exact replacement for nonlinear BETAW.
consequence.SWQHR2_mapping: Direct tabular legacy Q(h) is conceptually close to a Ribasim table, but interpolation and legacy HBWEIR threshold semantics require an explicit error/semantics qualification.

next_required_test.purpose: Determine whether nonlinear SWQHR1 parity is required by the intended coupled application envelope. If required, preregister a representation strategy and quantify its error; do not claim exactness from native PCHIP tables.
strategy_options: PCHIP table under a declared approximation envelope
external exact hydraulic-law evaluation feeding an explicitly supported Ribasim control seam, if such a writable seam is independently qualified
explicit exclusion of nonlinear SWQHR1 from the coupled application contract while retaining standalone SWAP5 capability
acceptance_axes: pointwise Q(h) representation error over declared head domain

retirement_effect: Whole legacy-container retirement in external-Ribasim mode is not blocked if the coupled application contract explicitly excludes nonlinear SWQHR1 parity and standalone SWAP5 retains its separately qualified capability. A claim of full legacy fixed-weir functional parity remains blocked until Q1C or an equivalent authority closes this gap.
